measurement_contract.host_workload_wall_ms: The unchanged benchmark host's steady-clock workload boundary from its raw JSON.
measurement_contract.total_observed: QPC wall time from the first instrumented phase entry until the recorder's atexit report. It includes startup and idle gaps and is not a pure workload measure.
measurement_contract.host_api_inclusive: Outermost public BlinkBackend LoadFile/Evaluate/Resize/Tick calls, including scheduling and every nested category.
measurement_contract.js_execution_boundaries_inclusive_native: Outermost actual JS_CallInternal execution (C cleanup runs on every return), ScriptRealm evaluation, pending-job drain, or facade ExecutionScope lifetime. Includes native callbacks and nested/reentrant execution, source/result conversion where applicable. Not pure-JS CPU time.
measurement_contract.native_callback_inclusive_reentrant_js: Outermost existing CallbackState boundary, including bridge setup/teardown and JS synchronously reentered by a native callback. Nested callback scopes are merged by category depth. Callsite RVAs are constructor return addresses; optimization/inlining can coarsen them, so they are call hot spots rather than exact callback identities.
measurement_contract.native_callback_targets: Actual function/access-check/property-handler/getter/setter/enumerator callback pointer invocations. Per-target elapsed time is inclusive of nested callbacks and synchronously reentrant JS; target totals overlap the aggregate callback category and can overlap one another.
measurement_contract.layout_lifecycle_inclusive: UpdateAllLifecyclePhases plus native input-state and popup lifecycle updates and their synchronous work.
measurement_contract.software_paint_inclusive: CPU surface wrapping, clear, main/popup PaintContent raster work, and generation update.
measurement_contract.paint_total_inclusive: Whole backend Paint method; overlaps layout_lifecycle and software_paint.
measurement_contract.joint_gc_host_cycle_inclusive: One automatic host GC cycle: QuickJS bridge pass, native cppgc pass, second QuickJS bridge pass, arena trim, and retained-size rebudgeting.
measurement_contract.quickjs_gc_inclusive: Each actual JS_RunGC body, including external joint tracing. It overlaps bridge and host-cycle metrics.
measurement_contract.cppgc_native_gc_inclusive: Each NativeHeap::Collect body. It overlaps host-cycle metrics when automatically collected.
measurement_contract.quickjs_bridge_gc_pass_inclusive: CollectQuickJSGarbage including JS_RunGC and weak-persistent processing; overlaps quickjs_gc and host-cycle metrics.
measurement_contract.overlap_rule: Only same-category nested scopes are merged. Different categories intentionally overlap and MUST NOT be summed or treated as disjoint percentages.
measurement_contract.pure_js_cpu: Not reported. Subtracting callbacks, GC, layout, or paint from inclusive JS/host clocks would not produce a defensible pure-JS value.
measurement_contract.clock_overhead: Each outermost category scope uses one QPC read at entry and exit; nested same-category scopes avoid QPC reads. Every category scope updates counters; callback-boundary entry also probes a fixed-capacity lock-free callsite table. Every actual callback-target invocation uses two QPC reads plus a fixed-capacity lock-free target-table probe. The measured back-to-back QPC lower bound is recorded but not subtracted.

process_cpu.interval: before View::Create through populated capture; excludes View and process teardown

total_observed.boundary: first instrumented phase entry through process atexit report
